Composio-managed OAuth needs no Fathom OAuth app or API key. In the Composio dashboard, open Toolkits , search for Fathom , and click Add to Project . Enter a Config Name and click Next . Select OAuth 2.0 , choose Composio Managed under Credentials , keep the public_api scope selected, and click Create Auth Config . Open the auth config and click Connect Account . In Fathom, check that the right account is signed in (click Change to switch), then click Allow Access . Under Accounts , confirm the connected account shows as Active . The auth config's Enabled status alone doesn't mean an account is connected. Can I connect Fathom with an API key instead? Yes. Create a key in Fathom under Settings > API Access , create a Fathom auth config with the API Key authentication type, and paste the key when you click Connect Account . The same API Access section is where Fathom offers its own OAuth app setup; see the Fathom developer documentation .
